text: I was offered $256,000 for the @pride username on Telegram. I don’t need the username. But if I sell, does that mean I sold my pride? 🤔
Apple finally made a phone that’s both too big and too small. It folds in half. Just like your enthusiasm. We still made Telegram look incredible at both wrong sizes. We do a lot of charity work.
🇮🇶 Iraq blocked Telegram (2nd time this year). We feel sorry for the Iraqi people. But we won’t censor free political speech. Regardless of how we are asked. ✊
